items.title: Wayne Shorter — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I said, “How did you get Bobby Hebb...where was Bobby Hebb...?” He said Bobby was not savvy at that time, you know. He wasn’t a businessman.

ctx.x: Good for him. I hope he didn’t sell the rights to that.

No. Ben was... He was a buyer. I mean, he wrote that, but he... I said, “How did you get Bobby Hebb...where was Bobby Hebb...?” He said Bobby was not savvy at that time, you know. He wasn’t a businessman. Anyway...
Anyway. Before we start, is there anything you particularly want to talk about, or things you don’t want to talk about?
